name: alphadeck-vue
description: Independent Vue 3 workbench with Python research and market services

scripts.dev:market: uv run --extra baostock --extra akshare --project services/market-data alphadeck-market-api
scripts.build:standalone: npm run build:vue && npm run check:standalone-runtime
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec timescaledb psql -U alphadeck -d alphadeck
scripts.db:init: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.database_cli init
scripts.db:doctor: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.database_cli doctor
scripts.obs:up: docker compose up -d loki grafana alloy
scripts.obs:down: docker compose stop loki grafana alloy
scripts.obs:logs: docker compose logs -f loki grafana alloy
scripts.auth:ensure-access-control: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.local_cli ensure-access-control
scripts.check:models: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.diagnostics_cli models
scripts.check:skills: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.skills_cli check --scripts
scripts.check:skills:metadata: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.skills_cli check
scripts.check:integrations: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.diagnostics_cli integrations
scripts.market:maintain: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.market_maintenance maintain
scripts.market:maintain:dry-run: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.market_maintenance maintain --dry-run
scripts.test:backend: uv run --project services/market-data --extra baostock --extra akshare --group dev python -m pytest -q services/market-data/tests
scripts.benchmark:quant:contract: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.benchmark_cli --mode contract
scripts.benchmark:quant:e2e: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.benchmark_cli --mode e2e
scripts.eval:ci: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.evaluation_ci --mode contract
scripts.eval:ci:e2e: uv run --directory services/platform-api --locked python -m alphadeck_platform.evaluation_ci --mode e2e
scripts.setup: npm run ensure:env && npm --prefix web ci && uv sync --directory services/platform-api --locked --group dev && uv sync --directory services/market-data --extra baostock --extra akshare --group dev
scripts.test: npm run test:platform && npm run test:backend
